svg.title: Least connections chooses the fewest active requests
svg.desc: The selector chooses B because B has the smallest active-request count.

g.text: Least connections: choose the smallest active count
This implementation counts active proxied requests, rather than open TCP connections.
New request starts on B: 1 -> 2 active. When it finishes: 2 -> 1 active.
The next selection scans the current counters again. Equal counts favor the first backend.
Selection and increment are separate: concurrent requests can choose the same backend
before either starts. Active request count is a load estimate, not a reservation.
